context: A boss and his manager discuss a corporate-wellness article
purpose: Teach: 干渉/内面/摩擦/葛藤/量的/見地/末期/糖尿

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員の糖尿予防、末期化を防ぐ取り組みを進めるべきだな。
lines.en: We should push forward with diabetes prevention initiatives among our staff—keep cases from progressing.
lines.style: Measured opening. Calm authority without force. Thoughtful pace. Slight pause after the dash, showing he's weighing the implications as he speaks.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。内面の葛藤、メンタル支援との連携が要です。
lines.en: Yes. The key is coordinating mental health support with addressing what staff are struggling with internally.
lines.style: Respectful and professional. Soft confirmation on the first word. Steady delivery—thinking as he speaks, not rehearsed. Clear-headed without being stiff.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 部署間の摩擦、量的に見える化したい。
lines.en: I want the friction between departments made visible in concrete numbers.
lines.style: Direct and measured. Light emphasis on 'concrete'—pragmatic. The tone of someone who believes data clarifies. Not harsh, but precise.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 外部干渉は最小限に、社内見地で進めます。
lines.en: We'll keep outside involvement to a minimum and move forward using internal perspective.
lines.style: Assured and matter-of-fact. No hesitation. Professional tone that signals this is settled. Slightly brisk—he's already thinking two steps ahead.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 来月の会議で、議論しよう。
lines.en: We'll discuss it at next month's meeting.
lines.style: Closing statement—slight drop in energy, signaling the discussion is winding down. Still composed. Finality without coldness.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.style: Brief and respectful. Quiet affirmation. The tone of someone who has what he needs and will act on it. No overeagerness.
